Theme

Latin word

rēs

rēs, reī f.

noun, fifth declension; opposed to verba

the content, as against the words; a thing that happens, an event, an affair; the fact, the facts, what really is (as against words or opinion); a thing, matter, occurrence; the matter in hand, the point; the matter, the situation; a thing, an object

  • phenomenon

    the recommended word · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. rēs: “a matter, affair, event, fact, circumstance, occurrence”

  • point

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Ad. 2.1.31: mitte ista, atque ad rem redī (Lewis & Short s.v. redeō); Cic. Caecin. 58: nihil ad rem pertinet (Lewis & Short s.v. ad); Traupman 105: beside the point; get to the point!; get the point?, nihil ad rem; venī ad rem!; tenēsne rem?

  • situation

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 3.24.2: tōta rēs quō locō sit; Liv. 2.47.5: quō locō rēs essent (Lewis & Short); Traupman 107: you see what the situation is, vidēs quō in locō haec rēs sit

    the recommended word · classical · Phaedr. 3.12.3: quanta rēs; Sen. Ep. 84.8: imāgō rēs mortua est
